newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: VEBA eyes overhaul of trade, transport unit.
newsitem.headline: VEBA eyes overhaul of trade, transport unit.

text.p: VEBA AG is mulling an overhaul of its trading and transport division with the view to concentrating on its most profitable activities, chairman Ulrich Hartmann said.
"In the area of trading and transport we are now analysing our portfolio," he told the International Management Symposium.

"We finally have to get away from being a collection basin for different activities -- some of them even with the character of mid-sized companies -- that cannot be operated better even by a large company," he said.
"We have to concentrate on the most profitable businessses that have international growth potential," he added, citing chemicals distribution, electronics trading and air cargo as examples.
Hartmann stressed VEBA's goal of expanding internationally, adding he aimed to have half the group's sales outside Germany by the year 2005.
He said VEBA's planned 36.4 percent stake in Degussa helped boost the international aspect of its chemicals business, primarily because of Degussa's strong position in the United States.
It also offered a joint platform to expand in Asia, he said.
